authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use second-class-applicable material only; exclude subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕.

allowed_distinctness_axes: different misconception with a materially different reasoning path
different aircraft or flight-method applicability where the source defines a real distinction
prohibited: backfilling low-value questions solely to hit a round number

execution_plan.objective: Complete the already-audited post-188 Operations gaps first.
Run systematic chapter/subsection coverage decomposition and author accepted batches across Rules, Systems, Operations and Risk until canonical accepted inventory reaches 350.
execution_plan.batch_size_guidance: Prefer 15-25 candidates per batch before review; smaller where source ceilings are reached.

execution_plan.objective: When 350 accepted, source-verified canonical questions exist, execute explicit release selection/activation and regenerate runtime assets under a new bank revision.

preserved_invariants: The currently released 188-question Production bank remains unchanged while expansion drafts are authored and reviewed.
DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000188 retain their existing identity, content, release history and first-use revision evidence.
The existing 20-question free selection remains unchanged until an explicit monetization decision changes it.
The immutable V0 100-question historical validation snapshot remains unchanged.
